scope: Powertrain (P) codes only. Ruled 2026-09-25: B/C/U families are out of scope, so no label covers them.
merges: fuel_injector: the misfire_triage injector component and dtc_family:P02 (injector circuit) are the same fault class, so they are one label.

transmission: dtc_family:P07 and P08 merged. The J2012 table and dtc_definitions.P_SUBSYSTEMS map second digits 7 and 8 to transmission. P09 is 'transmission or control module' and is routed by repair text, not by family.

labels.label: vacuum_intake_leak
labels.description: Unmetered air entering after the mass airflow sensor: intake boot, vacuum or PCV hoses, intake manifold gasket.

labels.label: fuel_delivery
labels.description: Fuel supply short of demand: fuel pump, filter, pressure regulator or rail pressure.

labels.label: maf_sensor
labels.description: Mass airflow sensor under-reading or contaminated.

labels.label: ignition_component
labels.description: Cylinder ignition parts: ignition coil, coil pack, spark plug or plug wire.

labels.label: fuel_injector
labels.description: Fuel injector or its circuit (merged with dtc_family:P02).

labels.label: oxygen_sensor
labels.description: Oxygen or air-fuel ratio sensor, its heater or wiring.

labels.label: evap_system
labels.description: Evaporative emissions leak or valve: purge or vent valve, canister, filler cap.

labels.label: valve_timing_air_aux
labels.description: P00xx: variable valve timing and camshaft phasing, turbo or boost control, auxiliary fuel/air metering.

labels.label: air_fuel_metering_other
labels.description: P01xx not covered by a rule: MAP, IAT, ECT and throttle position sensors, thermostat, throttle body.

labels.label: ignition_system_sensor
labels.description: P03xx other than misfire: crankshaft and camshaft position sensors, knock sensors.

labels.label: emissions_control_other
labels.description: P04xx not covered by a rule: EGR, secondary air injection.

labels.label: idle_speed_auxiliary
labels.description: P05xx: idle control, vehicle speed sensor, charging system voltage, oil pressure sensor.

labels.label: control_module
labels.description: P06xx: engine or powertrain control module and its outputs, including reflash or replacement.

labels.label: transmission
labels.description: P07xx and P08xx (merged): transmission, torque converter, shift solenoids, TCM.
